layout: app/modules/health/ — 6 registered function groups (health_liveness, health_readiness, health_metrics, health_metrics_json, health_system_dashboard, health_api_summary). Derived record: page layout not yet described.
output_how: Registered function groups return named outputs (checks, html, metrics, status, summary, timestamp) via the module's routes/services.
output_why: Serves the Health functions declared in its FunctionGroupContracts.
process_description: CANONICAL liveness probe. Returns 200 if the app process is running. Used by Kubernetes/Render liveness checks. CANONICAL readiness probe. Returns 200 if the app is ready to serve traffic (database connected, migrations applied). Used by Kubernetes/Render readiness checks. CANONICAL Prometheus-compatible metrics endpoint. Returns app metrics in Prometheus text format. Used by monitoring systems. CANONICAL JSON metrics endpoint for non-Prometheus consumers. Returns the same metrics as the Prometheus endpoint but as JSON. CANONICAL visual system dashboard. Returns an HTML page showing all system capabilities and health status. Admin-only. CANONICAL JSON summary of all API capabilities. Returns a programmatic summary of all endpoints and their status. Used for API discovery.
process_context: Derived record. Invoked via the health module's registered routes and dependencies.

minimum_surface.goal: Answer deployment probes and monitoring: is the app alive, is it ready, and what are its metrics.

extras.name: /livez
extras.justification: Kubernetes liveness convention — probe stacks configured for /livez reach the same liveness answer as /healthz; serves the goal across platform conventions.

extras.name: /health
extras.justification: Render's default health-check path — without it the platform's own deploy probe misses the liveness answer.

extras.name: /api/health
extras.justification: Namespaced health path for monitors and consumers that only probe /api/* routes; same liveness goal, wider reach.

extras.name: /metrics/json
extras.justification: JSON metrics for consumers that cannot parse Prometheus text format — same monitoring goal, different wire format (health_metrics_json contract).

extras.name: /api-summary
extras.justification: Programmatic endpoint inventory for API discovery — serves the 'what can I call' half of monitoring (health_api_summary contract).

extras.name: /system-dashboard
extras.justification: Admin-only visual health page — the human monitoring surface the JSON endpoints cannot serve (health_system_dashboard contract).
